key_highlights: ASX flat overall; miners and tech lead gains while oil stocks struggle on diesel supply concerns
Australian flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand amid RBA rate-hike pressure on households
Global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) to persist into 2027; Saudi oil shock spikes Australian fuel prices
Property market weakens: rising listings, falling demand, prices under pressure
Gold exploration sector active: Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill all advancing projects
Fed raised rates for first time since 2023; hawkish tone lifts USD, pressures gold
Chinese property recovery uncertain; Xi under political pressure, China pivoting to robotics
Jetstar and Virgin industrial action escalates, pressuring Qantas (QAN.AX) group

sectors.trend: Miners outperform on ASX; gold exploration names (Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill) active. Oil miners under pressure from diesel supply disruption. Iron ore steady but Chinese demand uncertain.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors offer relative strength; oil-exposed miners (WDS.AX, WMC.AX) face margin pressure. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX supported by commodity resilience but capped by China softness.

sectors.trend: Diesel shortage crisis dominates; Saudi oil shock spikes fuel prices. Trump mulls nuclear diesel option. Global supply gap to 2027. Energy cost politics (Labor vs Coalition) intensify.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from higher oil prices but diesel logistics risk weighs. Retail fuel margins compress. Energy cost inflation pressures RBA path.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending; property market softening (rising listings, falling demand). Government debt trajectory concerning. NIMs supported by higher rates but credit risk rising.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk from property and household stress. Rate-sensitive REITs under pressure. Monitor RBA next meeting closely.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks lead ASX higher post Wall Street surge. Data centre build-out straining net-zero targets. China pivoting to robotics sector.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (SOL.AX, WCN.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global risk-on. Data centre energy demand a structural tailwind for utilities. China robotics theme may lift ASX industrials.

sectors.trend: Myer jumps on ASX. Household spending squeezed by RBA hikes and energy costs. Jetstar/Virgin industrial action disrupts travel. Qantas announces SYD-JFK non-stop.
sectors.implications: MYR.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from squeezed consumers. QAN.AX benefits from route expansion but faces Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial risk. Travel sector volatile.

sectors.trend: Syngenis launches precision medicine venture. CSL remains defensive anchor. US healthcare REITs seeing fund exits despite bullish outlook.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SYG.AX offer defensive positioning. Precision medicine theme supports long-term biotech valuations. Monitor CSL pipeline updates.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand push property prices lower. Curbline Properties (CURB) flagged as attractive. Government debt cliff pressures fiscal support.
sectors.implications: ASX REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX) face occupancy and valuation headwinds. Residential property weakness a leading indicator for bank credit risk.

key_themes: Diesel supply crisis as macro overhang into 2027
RBA tightening cycle vs softening PMI and household stress
Gold exploration sector rotation in ASX small caps
China property and economic uncertainty weighing on commodity demand
Industrial action in aviation sector (Jetstar, Virgin)
US Fed hawkish pivot lifting USD, pressuring AUD and gold

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel shortage / energy supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour integrated majors (WDS.AX, BHP.AX) over pure-play oil. Monitor APM and Platts diesel benchmarks.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes and household credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favour dividend-paying defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX). Monitor NAB/CBA credit commentary.
Diversify away from China-exposed miners (RIO.AX, FMG.AX). Watch PBOC policy and property data.
Underweight cyclical consumer (WOW.AX, MYR.AX); favour staples and healthcare.
Avoid JLH.AX and QAN.AX short-term; monitor union negotiations.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: USD strength / AUD weakness from hawkish Fed
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour USD-revenue earners. Monitor AUD/USD 0.65 support.

opportunities.rationale: Active project pipeline (Platina WA, Dalaroo Côte d'Ivoire, Advance Mexico, Broken Hill SA) with USD strength and geopolitical risk supporting gold. Fed hawkishness adds safe-haven bid.

opportunities.recommendation: Add to defensive healthcare and staples
opportunities.rationale: Syngenis precision medicine expansion; CSL pipeline depth. Defensive positioning amid PMI weakness and rate-hike cycle.
Diesel shortage to 2027 supports oil prices; integrated majors benefit from pricing power while managing logistics risk.

defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese property recovery uncertain; Xi under political pressure; demand for iron ore and coal at risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid aviation names amid industrial action
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar and Virgin disputes escalating; revenue disruption and cost overhang for Qantas group.
Rising listings, falling demand, price declines; household credit stress from RBA hikes.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative. Diesel crisis and PMI weakness cap upside; tech and gold provide pockets of strength. RBA hawkish bias and USD strength weigh on AUD and risk assets. Aviation industrial action adds volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight range with sector rotation favouring gold, healthcare, and energy majors.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural diesel supply gap into 2027, Chinese demand uncertainty, and Australian fiscal concerns (debt cliff, bigger/poorer population) create headwinds. Gold and energy remain structurally supported. Tech and data centre demand offer growth pockets. RBA likely to hold or cut later in 2026 if PMI deteriorates further, supporting banks and property recovery.

Australian PMI and CPI data releases
Diesel supply resolution / Trump nuclear diesel policy
Fed policy path and USD trajectory
Gold price direction post-Fed hawkish shift
watch_list: Iron ore, LNG, gold spot prices
Australian flash PMI / NAB business conditions
Chinese property sales and PBOC policy
